appDescription: A server-first starter for multi-tenant SaaS — dashboard, authentication, organizations, and file storage.

home.headline: <line>A server-first</line><line><accent>starter</accent></line>
home.lede: Multi-tenant from the start: a <next>Next.js</next> dashboard, <auth>Better Auth</auth>, Postgres, and <storage>dimah-s3</storage>.

server.title: Session stays on the server
server.description: The dashboard reads the session in React Server Components. The UI does not call an auth client.

writes.title: Writes are Server Actions
writes.description: Auth, organizations, and uploads change on the server, then refresh the tagged cache.

chrome.title: Your chrome, your copy
chrome.description: The sidebar, org switcher, and menus belong to the app. Messages and RTL live in the i18n package.
